subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should shared channel setup standardize `beforePersistentEffect` as the adapter-level boundary that disables Back navigation and retains only accepted external-plugin installation metadata?
rationale: The implementation is internally coherent and tested, but choosing which adapter operations are replay-safe or durable is a cross-plugin compatibility contract rather than a mechanical defect that review automation can resolve.

options.title: Approve the shared boundary
options.body: Accept the proposed lifecycle contract and merge after the setup owner confirms adapters must declare their first durable effect through this hook.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep Back limited to adapters with an already-established persistence boundary and design a more explicit shared adapter contract before extending it broadly.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed lifecycle contract and merge after the setup owner confirms adapters must declare their first durable effect through this hook.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the shared setup/cancellation surface provides the strongest available context for explaining the proposed contract to the eventual setup-area decision owner.
